content: After Pīr-Muḥammad was murdered in 812/1409 his brother Iskandar Mīrzā took his place in Shiraz and soon established a brilliant court in Isfahan; he too made Ibn Turka a member of his court and bestowed similar honours, 'presumably' including a teaching post and judgeship (Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II, 212). The 'presumably' is Melvin-Koushki's.
